# NEW 2026-11-22 v13.6 Worker 3: Celestial Empire 3.0 — 10 Trans-Continental Grand Protectorates, Myriad Nations Tribute & Twin Suns Diplomacy (oe_cel3_, 0 mainline slots, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v136_celestial3.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Subject scope. Applies the reigning overlord dynasty's official title and adjective for var:oe_cel3_zone_id (1..10).
oe_cel3_apply_duhu_name = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
			has_variable = oe_cel3_zone_id
			exists = overlord
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:oe_cel3_zone_id ?= 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { overlord ?= { oe_cel_is_yuan_track = yes } }
				change_country_name = oe_scn_cel3_z01_yuan
				change_country_adjective = oe_scn_cel3_z01_yuan_ADJ
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { overlord ?= { oe_cel_is_han_ming_track = yes } }
				change_country_name = oe_scn_cel3_z01_ming
				change_country_adjective = oe_scn_cel3_z01_ming_ADJ
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { overlord ?= { oe_cel_is_manchu_qing_track = yes } }
				change_country_name = oe_scn_cel3_z01_qing
				change_country_adjective = oe_scn_cel3_z01_qing_ADJ
			}
			else = {
				change_country_name = oe_scn_cel3_z01_alt
				change_country_adjective = oe_scn_cel3_z01_alt_ADJ
			}
		}
		else_if = {

# Country scope (emperor). Refreshes dynasty-adaptive titles on every W3 Grand Protectorate.
oe_cel3_refresh_all_duhu_names = {
	every_subject = {
		limit = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
			has_variable = oe_cel3_zone_id
		}
		oe_cel3_apply_duhu_name = yes
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Milestones & Sync Helper
# ==============================================================================

# Country scope (emperor). Syncs v11.2 counts and checks 5-zone / 8-zone milestones.
oe_cel3_sync_milestones = {
	oe_cel_sync_duhu_count = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_cel3_active_zones_val >= 2
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel3_seal_ev_done }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_seal_ev_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel3.4
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_cel3_active_zones_val >= 5
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel3_five_zones_done }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_five_zones_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel3.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_cel3_active_zones_val >= 8
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel3_eight_zones_done }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_eight_zones_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel3.6
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# 10 One-Click Grand Protectorate Charter Effects (never cedes emperor's capital!)
# ==============================================================================

# Country scope (emperor). Charters Zone 1: Anxi (Western Regions & Central Asia).
oe_cel3_charter_zone_1 = {
	save_scope_as = oe_cel3_emperor
	every_owned_location = {
		limit = {
			is_capital = no
			oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_1 = yes
		}
		add_to_list = oe_cel3_zone_locs
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			owns = location:kashgar
			location:kashgar = { is_capital = no }
		}
		location:kashgar = { save_scope_as = oe_cel3_cap }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			owns = location:samarkand
			location:samarkand = { is_capital = no }
		}
		location:samarkand = { save_scope_as = oe_cel3_cap }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			owns = location:turpan
			location:turpan = { is_capital = no }
		}
		location:turpan = { save_scope_as = oe_cel3_cap }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			owns = location:hami
			location:hami = { is_capital = no }
		}
		location:hami = { save_scope_as = oe_cel3_cap }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			owns = location:lhasa
			location:lhasa = { is_capital = no }
		}
		location:lhasa = { save_scope_as = oe_cel3_cap }
	}
	else = {
		random_in_list = {
			list = oe_cel3_zone_locs
			save_scope_as = oe_cel3_cap
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:oe_cel3_cap }
		scope:oe_cel3_cap = {
			create_country_from_location = {
				overlord = scope:oe_cel3_emperor
				subject_type = subject_type:oe_cel_grand_duhu
				change_government_type = government_type:monarchy
				change_country_type = location
				set_capital = scope:oe_cel3_cap
				set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_zone_id value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_name_full_title value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_cel_named_duhu value = 1 }
				save_scope_as = oe_cel3_new_duhu
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_cel3_new_duhu }
			scope:oe_cel3_cap = {
				add_core = scope:oe_cel3_new_duhu
			}
			every_in_list = {
				list = oe_cel3_zone_locs
				limit = {
					NOT = { this = scope:oe_cel3_cap }
					owner ?= scope:oe_cel3_emperor
					is_capital = no
				}
				change_location_owner = scope:oe_cel3_new_duhu
				change_location_controller = scope:oe_cel3_new_duhu
				add_core = scope:oe_cel3_new_duhu
			}
			scope:oe_cel3_new_duhu = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:oe_cel3_emperor } }
					make_subject_of = {
						target = scope:oe_cel3_emperor
						type = subject_type:oe_cel_grand_duhu
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu } }
					change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_cel_grand_duhu
				}
				oe_cel3_apply_duhu_name = yes
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel3_duhu_charter_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
				add_opinion = { target = scope:oe_cel3_emperor modifier = oe_cel_op_enfeoffed }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel3_first_duhu_done } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_first_duhu_done value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel3.1
			}
			oe_cel3_sync_milestones = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (emperor). Charters Zone 2: Beiting (Steppe & Siberia).

	save_scope_as = oe_cel3_emperor
	every_owned_location = {
		limit = {
			is_capital = no
			oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_2 = yes
		}
		add_to_list = oe_cel3_zone_locs
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			owns = location:tobolsk
			location:tobolsk = { is_capital = no }
		}
		location:tobolsk = { save_scope_as = oe_cel3_cap }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			owns = location:irkutsk
			location:irkutsk = { is_capital = no }
		}
		location:irkutsk = { save_scope_as = oe_cel3_cap }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			owns = location:astrakhan
			location:astrakhan = { is_capital = no }
		}
		location:astrakhan = { save_scope_as = oe_cel3_cap }
	}
	else = {
		random_in_list = {
			list = oe_cel3_zone_locs
			save_scope_as = oe_cel3_cap
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:oe_cel3_cap }
		scope:oe_cel3_cap = {
			create_country_from_location = {
				overlord = scope:oe_cel3_emperor
				subject_type = subject_type:oe_cel_grand_duhu
				change_government_type = government_type:monarchy
				change_country_type = location
				set_capital = scope:oe_cel3_cap
				set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_zone_id value = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_name_full_title value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_cel_named_duhu value = 1 }
				save_scope_as = oe_cel3_new_duhu
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_cel3_new_duhu }
			scope:oe_cel3_cap = {
				add_core = scope:oe_cel3_new_duhu
			}
			every_in_list = {
				list = oe_cel3_zone_locs
				limit = {
					NOT = { this = scope:oe_cel3_cap }
					owner ?= scope:oe_cel3_emperor
					is_capital = no
				}
				change_location_owner = scope:oe_cel3_new_duhu
				change_location_controller = scope:oe_cel3_new_duhu
				add_core = scope:oe_cel3_new_duhu
			}
			scope:oe_cel3_new_duhu = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:oe_cel3_emperor } }
					make_subject_of = {
						target = scope:oe_cel3_emperor
						type = subject_type:oe_cel_grand_duhu
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu } }
					change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_cel_grand_duhu
				}
				oe_cel3_apply_duhu_name = yes
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel3_duhu_charter_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
				add_opinion = { target = scope:oe_cel3_emperor modifier = oe_cel_op_enfeoffed }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel3_first_duhu_done } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_first_duhu_done value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel3.1
			}
			oe_cel3_sync_milestones = yes
		}
	}
}

			scope:oe_cel3_new_duhu = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:oe_cel3_emperor } }
					make_subject_of = {
						target = scope:oe_cel3_emperor
						type = subject_type:oe_cel_grand_duhu
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu } }
					change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_cel_grand_duhu
				}
				oe_cel3_apply_duhu_name = yes
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel3_duhu_charter_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
				add_opinion = { target = scope:oe_cel3_emperor modifier = oe_cel_op_enfeoffed }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel3_first_duhu_done } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_first_duhu_done value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel3.1
			}
			oe_cel3_sync_milestones = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (emperor). Charters Zone 4: Annam (Mainland Indochina).
oe_cel3_charter_zone_4 = {
	save_scope_as = oe_cel3_emperor
	every_owned_location = {
		limit = {
			is_capital = no
			oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_4 = yes
		}
		add_to_list = oe_cel3_zone_locs
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			owns = location:thang_long
			location:thang_long = { is_capital = no }
		}
		location:thang_long = { save_scope_as = oe_cel3_cap }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			owns = location:angkor
			location:angkor = { is_capital = no }
		}
		location:angkor = { save_scope_as = oe_cel3_cap }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			owns = location:pegu
			location:pegu = { is_capital = no }
		}
		location:pegu = { save_scope_as = oe_cel3_cap }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			owns = location:vientiane
			location:vientiane = { is_capital = no }
		}
		location:vientiane = { save_scope_as = oe_cel3_cap }
	}
	else = {
		random_in_list = {
			list = oe_cel3_zone_locs
			save_scope_as = oe_cel3_cap
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:oe_cel3_cap }
		scope:oe_cel3_cap = {
			create_country_from_location = {
				overlord = scope:oe_cel3_emperor
				subject_type = subject_type:oe_cel_grand_duhu
				change_government_type = government_type:monarchy
				change_country_type = location
				set_capital = scope:oe_cel3_cap
				set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_zone_id value = 4 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_name_full_title value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_cel_named_duhu value = 1 }
				save_scope_as = oe_cel3_new_duhu
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_cel3_new_duhu }
			scope:oe_cel3_cap = {
				add_core = scope:oe_cel3_new_duhu
			}
			every_in_list = {
				list = oe_cel3_zone_locs
				limit = {
					NOT = { this = scope:oe_cel3_cap }
					owner ?= scope:oe_cel3_emperor
					is_capital = no
				}
				change_location_owner = scope:oe_cel3_new_duhu
				change_location_controller = scope:oe_cel3_new_duhu
				add_core = scope:oe_cel3_new_duhu
			}
			scope:oe_cel3_new_duhu = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:oe_cel3_emperor } }
					make_subject_of = {
						target = scope:oe_cel3_emperor
						type = subject_type:oe_cel_grand_duhu
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu } }
					change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_cel_grand_duhu
				}
				oe_cel3_apply_duhu_name = yes
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel3_duhu_charter_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
				add_opinion = { target = scope:oe_cel3_emperor modifier = oe_cel_op_enfeoffed }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel3_first_duhu_done } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_first_duhu_done value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel3.1
			}
			oe_cel3_sync_milestones = yes
		}
	}
}

					make_subject_of = {
						target = scope:oe_cel3_emperor
						type = subject_type:oe_cel_grand_duhu
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu } }
					change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_cel_grand_duhu
				}
				oe_cel3_apply_duhu_name = yes
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel3_duhu_charter_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
				add_opinion = { target = scope:oe_cel3_emperor modifier = oe_cel_op_enfeoffed }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel3_first_duhu_done } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_first_duhu_done value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel3.1
			}
			oe_cel3_sync_milestones = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (emperor). Charters Zone 10: Xinzhou (Pacific Americas).
oe_cel3_charter_zone_10 = {
	save_scope_as = oe_cel3_emperor
	every_owned_location = {
		limit = {
			is_capital = no
			oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_10 = yes
		}
		add_to_list = oe_cel3_zone_locs
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			owns = location:payomkawichum
			location:payomkawichum = { is_capital = no }
		}
		location:payomkawichum = { save_scope_as = oe_cel3_cap }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			owns = location:yaanga
			location:yaanga = { is_capital = no }
		}
		location:yaanga = { save_scope_as = oe_cel3_cap }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			owns = location:qusqu
			location:qusqu = { is_capital = no }
		}
		location:qusqu = { save_scope_as = oe_cel3_cap }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			owns = location:quito
			location:quito = { is_capital = no }
		}
		location:quito = { save_scope_as = oe_cel3_cap }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			owns = location:tenochtitlan
			location:tenochtitlan = { is_capital = no }
		}
		location:tenochtitlan = { save_scope_as = oe_cel3_cap }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			owns = location:panama
			location:panama = { is_capital = no }
		}
		location:panama = { save_scope_as = oe_cel3_cap }
	}
	else = {
		random_in_list = {
			list = oe_cel3_zone_locs
			save_scope_as = oe_cel3_cap
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:oe_cel3_cap }
		scope:oe_cel3_cap = {
			create_country_from_location = {
				overlord = scope:oe_cel3_emperor
				subject_type = subject_type:oe_cel_grand_duhu
				change_government_type = government_type:monarchy
				change_country_type = location
				set_capital = scope:oe_cel3_cap
				set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_zone_id value = 10 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_name_full_title value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_cel_named_duhu value = 1 }
				save_scope_as = oe_cel3_new_duhu
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_cel3_new_duhu }
			scope:oe_cel3_cap = {
				add_core = scope:oe_cel3_new_duhu
			}
			every_in_list = {
				list = oe_cel3_zone_locs
				limit = {
					NOT = { this = scope:oe_cel3_cap }
					owner ?= scope:oe_cel3_emperor
					is_capital = no
				}
				change_location_owner = scope:oe_cel3_new_duhu
				change_location_controller = scope:oe_cel3_new_duhu
				add_core = scope:oe_cel3_new_duhu
			}
			scope:oe_cel3_new_duhu = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:oe_cel3_emperor } }
					make_subject_of = {
						target = scope:oe_cel3_emperor
						type = subject_type:oe_cel_grand_duhu
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu } }
					change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_cel_grand_duhu
				}
				oe_cel3_apply_duhu_name = yes
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cel3_duhu_charter_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
				add_opinion = { target = scope:oe_cel3_emperor modifier = oe_cel_op_enfeoffed }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel3_first_duhu_done } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_first_duhu_done value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel3.1
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel3_xinzhou_ev_done } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_xinzhou_ev_done value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel3.12
			}
			oe_cel3_sync_milestones = yes
		}
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Diplomatic Interaction Helper: Grant Same-Zone Frontier Lands to Active Protectorate
# ==============================================================================

# Country scope (scope:actor). Transfers all owned non-capital locations in scope:recipient's zone.
oe_cel3_grant_zone_lands_to_recipient = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:recipient
			scope:recipient = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				is_subject_of = prev
				is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
				has_variable = oe_cel3_zone_id
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { var:oe_cel3_zone_id ?= 1 } }
			every_owned_location = {
				limit = {
					is_capital = no
					oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_1 = yes
				}
				change_location_owner = scope:recipient
				change_location_controller = scope:recipient
				add_core = scope:recipient
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { var:oe_cel3_zone_id ?= 2 } }
			every_owned_location = {
				limit = {
					is_capital = no
					oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_2 = yes
				}
				change_location_owner = scope:recipient
				change_location_controller = scope:recipient
				add_core = scope:recipient
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { var:oe_cel3_zone_id ?= 3 } }
			every_owned_location = {
				limit = {
					is_capital = no
					oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_3 = yes
				}
				change_location_owner = scope:recipient
				change_location_controller = scope:recipient
				add_core = scope:recipient
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { var:oe_cel3_zone_id ?= 4 } }
			every_owned_location = {
				limit = {
					is_capital = no
					oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_4 = yes
				}
				change_location_owner = scope:recipient
				change_location_controller = scope:recipient
				add_core = scope:recipient
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { var:oe_cel3_zone_id ?= 5 } }
			every_owned_location = {
				limit = {
					is_capital = no
					oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_5 = yes
				}
				change_location_owner = scope:recipient
				change_location_controller = scope:recipient
				add_core = scope:recipient
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { var:oe_cel3_zone_id ?= 6 } }
			every_owned_location = {
				limit = {
					is_capital = no
					oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_6 = yes
				}
				change_location_owner = scope:recipient
				change_location_controller = scope:recipient
				add_core = scope:recipient
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { var:oe_cel3_zone_id ?= 7 } }
			every_owned_location = {
				limit = {
					is_capital = no
					oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_7 = yes
				}
				change_location_owner = scope:recipient
				change_location_controller = scope:recipient
				add_core = scope:recipient
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { var:oe_cel3_zone_id ?= 8 } }
			every_owned_location = {
				limit = {
					is_capital = no
					oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_8 = yes
				}
				change_location_owner = scope:recipient
				change_location_controller = scope:recipient
				add_core = scope:recipient
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { var:oe_cel3_zone_id ?= 9 } }
			every_owned_location = {
				limit = {
					is_capital = no
					oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_9 = yes
				}
				change_location_owner = scope:recipient
				change_location_controller = scope:recipient
				add_core = scope:recipient
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { var:oe_cel3_zone_id ?= 10 } }
			every_owned_location = {
				limit = {
					is_capital = no
					oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_10 = yes
				}
				change_location_owner = scope:recipient
				change_location_controller = scope:recipient
				add_core = scope:recipient
			}
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			add_liberty_desire = -8
			add_opinion = { target = prev modifier = oe_cel_op_enfeoffed }
		}
		add_prestige = 3
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# 5-Year Myriad Nations Tribute Trade & Economic Reflux Engine
# ==============================================================================

# Country scope (emperor). Injects matching tribute market demands, merchant power, CA & silver.
oe_cel3_run_tribute_cycle = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel3_tribute_cycles } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_tribute_cycles value = 0 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_cel3_tribute_cycles add = 1 }
	save_scope_as = oe_cel3_tribute_host
	if = {
		limit = { exists = capital }
		capital = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = market }
				market = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:oe_cel3_tribute_host = {
								OR = {
									oe_cel3_has_asia_maritime_tribute = yes
									oe_cel3_active_continents_val < 1
								}
							}
						}
						if = {
							limit = { scope:oe_cel3_tribute_host = { oe_cel3_active_continents_val >= 3 } }
							add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:oe_cel3_dem_tribute_asia scale = 1.5 months = 60 }
						}
						else = {
							add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:oe_cel3_dem_tribute_asia scale = 1.0 months = 60 }
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { scope:oe_cel3_tribute_host = { oe_cel3_has_steppe_persia_tribute = yes } }
						if = {
							limit = { scope:oe_cel3_tribute_host = { oe_cel3_active_continents_val >= 3 } }
							add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:oe_cel3_dem_tribute_steppe_persia scale = 1.5 months = 60 }
						}
						else = {
							add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:oe_cel3_dem_tribute_steppe_persia scale = 1.0 months = 60 }
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { scope:oe_cel3_tribute_host = { oe_cel3_has_continent_europe = yes } }
						add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:oe_cel3_dem_tribute_europe_med scale = 1.5 months = 60 }
					}
					if = {
						limit = { scope:oe_cel3_tribute_host = { oe_cel3_has_continent_americas = yes } }
						add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:oe_cel3_dem_tribute_americas scale = 1.5 months = 60 }
					}
					if = {
						limit = { scope:oe_cel3_tribute_host = { oe_cel3_active_continents_val >= 5 } }
						add_merchant_power = { country = scope:oe_cel3_tribute_host power = 45 key = oe_cel3_myriad_tribute_mp months = 60 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:oe_cel3_tribute_host = { oe_cel3_active_continents_val >= 4 } }
						add_merchant_power = { country = scope:oe_cel3_tribute_host power = 38 key = oe_cel3_myriad_tribute_mp months = 60 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:oe_cel3_tribute_host = { oe_cel3_active_continents_val >= 3 } }
						add_merchant_power = { country = scope:oe_cel3_tribute_host power = 30 key = oe_cel3_myriad_tribute_mp months = 60 }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:oe_cel3_tribute_host = { oe_cel3_active_continents_val >= 2 } }
						add_merchant_power = { country = scope:oe_cel3_tribute_host power = 22 key = oe_cel3_myriad_tribute_mp months = 60 }
					}
					else = {
						add_merchant_power = { country = scope:oe_cel3_tribute_host power = 15 key = oe_cel3_myriad_tribute_mp months = 60 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { oe_cel3_active_continents_val >= 5 }
		change_celestial_authority = { value = 6 }
		add_gold = 600
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { oe_cel3_active_continents_val >= 4 }
		change_celestial_authority = { value = 5 }
		add_gold = 480
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { oe_cel3_active_continents_val >= 3 }
		change_celestial_authority = { value = 4 }
		add_gold = 360
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { oe_cel3_active_continents_val >= 2 }
		change_celestial_authority = { value = 3 }
		add_gold = 240
	}
	else = {
		change_celestial_authority = { value = 2 }
		add_gold = 120
	}
	if = {
		limit = { oe_cel3_active_continents_val >= 3 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel3.3
	}
	else = {
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel3.2
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Twin Suns Pacific / Indian Ocean & Eurasian Concert Diplomacy Check
# ==============================================================================

# Country scope (emperor). Evaluates cross-ocean Twin Suns events (oe_cel3.7-.9).
oe_cel3_check_twin_suns_diplomacy = {
	# 1. Pacific Twin Suns (oe_cel3.7): Fusang/Xinzhou protectorate + settled Nova Elysia.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel3_pacific_accord_done }
			oe_cel3_has_pacific_duhu = yes
			has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled
			any_country = {
				oe_ely_is_elysian_host = yes
				NOT = { this = root }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_pacific_accord_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel3.7
	}
	# 2. Indian Ocean Twin Phoenixes (oe_cel3.8): Nanyang/Xiyang protectorate + Roman/Nostos partner in Red Sea/IO.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel3_indian_accord_done }
			oe_cel3_has_indian_ocean_duhu = yes
			OR = {
				AND = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { NOT = { this = root } oe_cel3_is_roman_io_partner = yes } }
				AND = { country_exists = c:ROM c:ROM = { NOT = { this = root } oe_cel3_is_roman_io_partner = yes } }
				AND = {
					has_global_variable = oe_elr_nostos_declared
					any_country = { NOT = { this = root } oe_cel3_is_roman_io_partner = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_indian_accord_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel3.8
	}
	# 3. Eurasian Concert Twin-Suns Co-Governance (oe_cel3.9): soft-linked to v12.0 oe_con_ (zero hard dep).
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel3_concert_accord_done }
			oe_cel3_active_zones_val >= 3
			OR = {
				exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
				has_global_variable = oe_con_resolutions_passed
				current_year >= 1650
			}
			OR = {
				AND = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { NOT = { this = root } oe_cel3_is_concert_western_partner = yes } }
				AND = { country_exists = c:ROM c:ROM = { NOT = { this = root } oe_cel3_is_concert_western_partner = yes } }
				AND = {
					has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled
					any_country = { NOT = { this = root } oe_cel3_is_concert_western_partner = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_concert_accord_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel3.9
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Main Yearly Pulse Entrypoint (called by Stage Integrator oe_v136_pulse.txt)
# ==============================================================================

# Country scope (Celestial Emperor, non-rebel). Runs once per year via yearly_country_pulse.
oe_cel3_yearly_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
		}
		# 1. Detect dynasty track switches and refresh all W3 protectorate titles.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel3_last_track } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_last_track value = oe_cel_track_value }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { var:oe_cel3_last_track = oe_cel_track_value } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_last_track value = oe_cel_track_value }
			oe_cel3_refresh_all_duhu_names = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					oe_cel3_active_zones_val >= 1
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel3_seal_ev_done }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_seal_ev_done value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel3.4
			}
		}
		# 2. Sync milestones (5-zone & 8-zone).
		oe_cel3_sync_milestones = yes
		# 3. 5-Year Myriad Nations Tribute cycle (only when holding >= 1 Grand Protectorate or Pacification Commission).
		if = {
			limit = { oe_cel3_has_tribute_subject = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel3_tribute_year_cnt } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_tribute_year_cnt value = 0 }
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_cel3_tribute_year_cnt add = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:oe_cel3_tribute_year_cnt >= 5 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_tribute_year_cnt value = 0 }
				oe_cel3_run_tribute_cycle = yes
			}
		}
		# 4. Periodic far-frontier protectorate loyalty audit (15-year cooldown, >= 2 active zones).
		if = {
			limit = {
				oe_cel3_active_zones_val >= 2
				oe_cel3_tribute_cycles_val >= 1
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_cel3_loyalty_audit_cd }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_cel3_loyalty_audit_cd years = 15 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel3.10
		}
		# 5. Twin Suns Pacific / Indian Ocean & Eurasian Concert diplomacy.
		oe_cel3_check_twin_suns_diplomacy = yes
	}
}

				change_location_owner = root
			}
